import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int[] dirX = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dirY = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static int gridSize, maxTimeAllowed, startXPos, startYPos;
    static String[] gridMap = new String[20], gridType = new String[20];
    static int[][][] memoTable = new int[12][12][12][12][62];
    static int[][] capacityMatrix = new int[250][250], parentNode = new int[250];
    static int[][] distArray = new int[20][20], visitedArray = new int[20][20];

    static boolean isAccessibleCell(int x, int y) {
        return 0 <= x && x < gridSize && 0 <= y && y < gridSize && gridType[x].charAt(y) != 'Y' && gridType[x].charAt(y) != 'Z';
    }

    static void computeShortestPaths() {
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(distArray[i], Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            Arrays.fill(visitedArray[i], 0);
        }
        distArray[startXPos][startYPos] = 0;
        visitedArray[startXPos][startYPos] = 1;
        Queue<Integer> qx = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new LinkedList<>();
        qx.offer(startXPos);
        qy.offer(startYPos);
        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            int x = qx.poll();
            int y = qy.poll();
            for (int moveIdx = 0; moveIdx < 4; moveIdx++) {
                int nx = x + dirX[moveIdx];
                int ny = y + dirY[moveIdx];
                if (isAccessibleCell(nx, ny) && visitedArray[nx][ny] == 0) {
                    distArray[nx][ny] = distArray[x][y] + 1;
                    visitedArray[nx][ny] = 1;
                    qx.offer(nx);
                    qy.offer(ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean findPath(int xA, int yA, int xB, int yB, int stepCount) {
        if (stepCount > maxTimeAllowed) return false;
        int res = memoTable[xA][yA][xB][yB][stepCount];
        if (res != -1) return res == 1;
        if (xA == xB && yA == yB) return distArray[xA][yA] >= stepCount;
        if (distArray[xA][yA] <= stepCount) return false;
        for (int moveIdx = 0; moveIdx < 4; moveIdx++) {
            int nx = xA + dirX[moveIdx];
            int ny = yA + dirY[moveIdx];
            if (isAccessibleCell(nx, ny) && findPath(nx, ny, xB, yB, stepCount + 1))
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static boolean maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(parentNode, -1);
        parentNode[s] = -2;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (int i = s; i <= t; i++) {
                if (parentNode[i] == -1 && capacityMatrix[v][i] > 0) {
                    parentNode[i] = v;
                    q.offer(i);
                }
            }
        }
        return parentNode[t] != -1;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        gridSize = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        maxTimeAllowed = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            gridMap[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            gridType[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        List<int[]> nodes = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> loadCap = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> supplyCap = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                char cellChar = gridMap[i].charAt(j);
                if (cellChar == 'Z') {
                    startXPos = i;
                    startYPos = j;
                } else if ('0' <= cellChar && cellChar <= '9') {
                    nodes.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    loadCap.add(cellChar - '0');
                    supplyCap.add(gridType[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        int m = nodes.size();
        for (int[] row : capacityMatrix) {
            Arrays.fill(row, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            capacityMatrix[0][i + 1] = supplyCap.get(i);
            capacityMatrix[m + 1 + i][2 * m + 1] = loadCap.get(i);
        }
        computeShortestPaths();
        for (int[][] layer : memoTable) {
            for (int[] row : layer) {
                Arrays.fill(row, -1);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int[] nodeA = nodes.get(i);
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                int[] nodeB = nodes.get(j);
                if (findPath(nodeA[0], nodeA[1], nodeB[0], nodeB[1], 0)) {
                    capacityMatrix[i + 1][m + 1 + j] = 1000;
                }
            }
        }
        int totalFlow = 0;
        int s = 0;
        int t = 2 * m + 1;
        while (maxFlow(s, t)) {
            int flowVal = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            int currentNode = t;
            while (parentNode[currentNode] >= 0) {
                flowVal = Math.min(flowVal, capacityMatrix[parentNode[currentNode]][currentNode]);
                currentNode = parentNode[currentNode];
            }
            currentNode = t;
            while (parentNode[currentNode] >= 0) {
                capacityMatrix[parentNode[currentNode]][currentNode] -= flowVal;
                capacityMatrix[currentNode][parentNode[currentNode]] += flowVal;
                currentNode = parentNode[currentNode];
            }
            totalFlow += flowVal;
        }
        System.out.println(totalFlow);
    }
}
